characteristics.name: Symbol Key
characteristics.$text: Cards marked with a dagger symbol (†) have not been officially released by Fantasy Flight Games. This information is based on official Fantasy Flight preview articles or early releases of product at tournaments or conventions. Cards maked with the dagger symbol may not have their final official text, are subject to change, and are generally not legal for tournament play.

characteristics.name: Symbol Key
characteristics.$text: Cards marked with a double dagger symbol (††) are not actual cards made by Fantasy Flight Games. They are not intended for game play and exist only to fill in blanks in the catalogue file.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Discard this card to attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose a stressed enemy ship at Range 1-2 and roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] or [critical] result, remove 1 stress token and deal it 1 facedown Damage card.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [SLAM] action icon. After you perform a SLAM action, discard this card.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are destroyed, each ship at Range 1 suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Combat phase, instead of performing any attacks, you may receive 1 ion token and suffer 1 damage to choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1. That ship suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may discard this card and receive 1 stress token. If you do, until the end of the round, when attacking or defending, you may change all of your [focus] results to [hit] or [evade] results.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver, you may discard this card to instead perform a white [stationary 0] maneuver. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard this card to drop one cargo token.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Perform a free cloak action. At the end of each round, if you are cloaked, roll 1 attack die. On a [focus] result, discard this card, then decloak or discard your cloak token.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Combat phase, instead of performing any attacks, you may discard this card to assign 2 ion tokens to each ship at Range 1.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Increase your hull value by 1.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Increase your shield value by 1.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Increase your agility value by 1. If you are hit by an attack, discard this card.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: After performing a SLAM action, if you did not overlap an obstacle or another ship, you may perform a free action on your action bar.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver that causes it to overlap your ship, roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] or [critical hit] result, the enemy ship suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, if you are inside the attacker's firing arc beyond Range 2 or outside the attacker's firing arc, you may change 1 of your blank results to a [evade] result.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may discard this card to increase your agility value by 1 until the end of the round. Then you may remove 1 enemy target lock from your ship.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [boost] action icon.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when attacking with a [torpedoes] or [missiles] secondary weapon, you may change 1 die result to a [hit] result (or a [critical] result if your primary weapon value is "3" or higher).

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver that causes it to overlap your ship, roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] or [critical hit] result, the enemy ship receives 1 ion token.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: You can acquire target locks on ships at Range 3 and beyond. You cannot acquire target locks on ships at Range 1-2.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with a secondary weapon that instructs you to discard it to perform the attack, do not discard it unless the attack hits.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When you either decloak or perform a cloak action, you may perform a free evade action.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Your ship can obstruct enemy attacks.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [target lock] icon.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after you perform an action, you may perform 1 free action from an equipped Upgrade card with the "Action:" header. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [barrel roll] action icon.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: You may treat all bank maneuvers ([left bank] or [right bank]) as green maneuvers.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [torpedoes] upgrade icon.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains two additional [bomb] upgrade icons.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. Increase your pilot skill value by 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. Decrease your pilot skill value by 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Increase your pilot skill value by 2.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [bomb] icon.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a red maneuver, you may discard this card to treat that maneuver as a white maneuver until the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When you receive a stress token, you may discard this card to assign 1 focus or evade token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking a ship inside your firing arc, at the start of the 'Compare Results' step, you may discard this card to cancel 1 of the defender's [evade] results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Execute a white [left turn 1] or [right turn 1] maneuver. Then, receive one stress token. Then, if you do not have the Boost action icon, roll 2 attack dice. Suffer any damage [hit] and critical damage [critical] rolled.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: You may treat the "Attack (target lock):" header as "Attack (focus):."  When an attack instructs you to spend a target lock, you may spend a focus token instead.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Exchange your pilot skill with that ship's pilot skill until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card with the Pilot trait, discard it immediately without resolving its effect.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship at Range 1 is hit by an attack, you may suffer 1 of the uncancelled [critical] results instead of the target ship.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, you may receive 1 stress token to choose 1 attack die. The attacker must reroll that die. If you have at least 1 stress token, you cannot use this ability.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Perform a free barrel roll action. If you do not have the [barrel roll] action icon, receive 1 stress token. You may then remove 1 enemy target lock token from your ship.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Until the end of the round, increase your primary weapon value by 1 and decrease your agility by 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: While you are touching an enemy ship, reduce that ship's agility value by 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you have an evade token, you may change 1 of the defender's [evade] results to a [focus] result.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a white or green maneuver on your dial, you may discard this card to rotate your ship 180°. Then receive 1 stress token after the "Check Pilot Stress" step.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: When attacking this round, you may change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical] result and all of your other [focus] results to [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if the defender does not have any focus or evade tokens, you may receive 1 stress token to roll 1 additional attack die. You cannot use this ability if you have any stress tokens.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking a ship inside your firing arc, if you are not inside that ship's firing arc, reduce its agility value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die. If the defender's pilot skill value is "2" or lower, you may instead reroll up to 2 attack dice.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after you perform an action, you may perform 1 free action shown in your action bar. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Assign 1 focus token to your ship and receive 2 stress tokens. Until the end of the round, when attacking, you may reroll up to 3 attack dice.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver, you may perform this attack against that ship. Attack: Attack 1 ship. You cannot modify your attack dice and cannot attack again this phase.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a maneuver, you may rotate your dial to another maneuver with the same speed. Treat your maneuver as a red maneuver.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1. Until the end of this phase, treat the chosen ship as if its pilot skill were equal to your pilot skill.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if the attack is obstructed, you may roll 1 additional attack die.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, remove 1 stress token from another friendly ship at Range 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking or defending, if you are stressed, you may reroll 1 or more of your [focus] results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: During setup, before the "Place Forces" step, choose 1 enemy ship and assign the "A Debt to Pay" Condition card to it. When attacking a ship that has the "A Debt to Pay" Condition card, you may change 1 [focus] result to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: When attacking a ship that has the "A Score to Settle" Upgrade card, you may change 1 [focus] result to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking or defending, if there are no other friendly ships at Range 1-2, you may reroll 1 of your blank results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose 1 ship at Range 1-2 that has a lower pilot skill than you. The chosen ship may immediately perform 1 free action.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When dropping a bomb, you may use the [straight 2] template instead of the [straight 1] template.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, you may reroll 1 of your [focus] results. If the attacker's pilot skill value is "2" or lower, you may reroll 1 of your blank results instead.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may immediately perform a primary weapon attack. You cannot perform another attack this round.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with a primary weapon, the defender must spend 1 focus token if able. When defending, the attacker must spend 1 focus token if able.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Activation phase, choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1-2. You may look at that ship's chosen maneuver.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking at Range 3, you may change 1 of your [hit] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a maneuver, you may rotate your dial to another maneuver with the same bearing. You cannot rotate to a red maneuver if you have any stress tokens.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After a friendly ship at Range 1-2 performs an attack that does not hit, you may assign 1 focus token to a friendly ship at Range 1-3 of the attacker.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a focus action, assign 1 additional focus token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1 and roll 1 attack die.  On a [hit] or [critical] result, choose 1 random facedown Damage card assigned to that ship, flip it faceup, and resolve it.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack against a ship inside your firing arc at Range 2, that ship receives 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking from your rear-facing auxiliary firing arc, reduce the defender's agility by 1 (to a minimum of "0").

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Energy: You may spend 1 energy to choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Acquire a target lock, then assign the blue target lock token to the chosen ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: You may maintain 2 target locks (only 1 per enemy ship). When you acquire a target lock you may lock onto 2 different ships.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: You cannot have more than 1 evade token. During the End phase, do not remove an unused evade token from your ship.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the "Place Forces" step, you may choose to treat your pilot skill value as "0," "6," or "12" until the end of the step. During setup, after another friendly ship is placed at Range 1-2, you may assign 1 focus or evade token to it.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: When executing a maneuver, you may resolve the "Check Pilot Stress" step after the "Perform Action" step (instead of before that step).

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: Stress tokens do not prevent you from performing boost or barrel roll actions unless you have 3 or more stress tokens.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your blank results to an [evade] result.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship at Range 1-2 is attacking a ship you have locked, the friendly ship treats the "Attack (target lock):" header as "Attack:." If a game effect instructs that ship to spend a target lock, it may spend your target lock instead.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your blank results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You cannot attack ships outside your firing arc. After you perform a primary weapon attack, you may immediately perform an attack with a [turret] secondary weapon.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End phase, do not remove unused focus tokens from your ship.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, during the "Modify Attack Dice" step, you may cancel all of your dice results. Then, you may add 2 [hit] results to your roll. Your dice cannot be modified again during this attack.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: Immediately before you reveal your maneuver, you may perform 1 free action. If you use this ability, you must skip your "Perform Action" step during this round.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: When performing a boost, barrel roll, or decloak, your ship and maneuver template can overlap obstacles. When rolling for obstacle damage, ignore all [critical] results.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: When you receive a stress token or an ion token, you may suffer 1 damage to discard that token.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Activation phase, treat your pilot skill value as "0."

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack, you may acquire a target lock on the defender.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: After defending, if you suffered a combination of 3 or more damage and critical damage during the attack, recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, you may change 1 of the attacker's [hit] results to a [focus] result. The attacker cannot reroll the die with the changed result.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. When attacking, you may change one of your [hit] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. Your [hit] results cannot be canceled by defense dice. The defender may cancel [critical] results before [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and, if the defender is not stressed, it also receives 1 stress token. Then, cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. Immediately after rolling your attack dice, you must change all of your [critical] results to [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and receives 1 ion token. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, the defender receives 1 tractor beam token. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc). Your [hit] results cannot be canceled by defense dice. The defender may cancel [critical hit] results before [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Spend 1 focus token to perform this attack against 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc). If the target of this attack is at Range 1, roll 1 additional attack die.

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc). If this attack hits the target ship, the ship suffers 1 damage and receives 1 ion token. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Perform this attack twice (even against a ship outside your firing arc). Each time this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, deal 1 faceup Damage card to the defender. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, each other ship at Range 1 of the defender suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack twice.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. You may change 1 of your blank results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. The defender cannot spend evade tokens during this attack.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and receives 2 ion tokens. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (focus): Discard this card to perform this attack. You may roll additional attack dice equal to your agility value, to a maximum of 3 additional dice.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (focus): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, each friendly ship at Range 1-2 of you may acquire a target lock on the defender. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard this card to drop 1 cluster mine token set. When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps a cluster mine token, that token detonates.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When one of these bomb tokens detonates, the ship that moved through or overlapped that token rolls 2 attack dice and suffers 1 damage for each [hit] and [critical] rolled. Then discard that token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard this card to drop 1 Conner net token. When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps this token, this token detonates.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, the ship that moved through or overlapped this token suffers 1 damage, receives 2 ion tokens, and skips its "Perform Action" step. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 ion bomb token. This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, each ship at Range 1 of the token receives 2 ion tokens. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 proton bomb token. This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, deal 1 faceup Damage card to each ship at Range 1 of the token. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard this card to drop 1 proximity mine token. When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps this token, this token detonates.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, the ship that moved through or overlapped this token rolls 3 attack dice and suffers all damage [hit] and critical damage [critical] rolled. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 seismic charge token. This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, each ship at Range 1 of the token suffers 1 damage. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 thermal detonator token. This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this bomb token detonates, each ship at Range 1 of the token suffers 1 damage and receives 1 stress token. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. You may change up to 3 of your blank results to [focus] results.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: When you equip this card, place 1 ordnance token on each equipped [torpedoes], [missiles], and [bomb] Upgrade card. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 ordnance token on that card instead.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card and spend your target lock to perform this attack. After you perform this attack, the defender receives 1 stress token if its hull value is "4" or lower.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, the defender and each ship at Range 1 of it receives 1 ion token.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, after dealing damage, remove 1 shield token from the defender.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack. You may change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical hit] result.

characteristics.name: Torpedoes Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Discard this card to choose an obstacle at Range 1-2 and inside your primary firing arc. Each ship at Range 1 of the obstacle rolls 1 attack die and suffers any damage [hit] or critical damage [critical] rolled. Then remove the obstacle.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after you perform an action that is not a recover or reinforce action, you may spend 1 energy to perform a free recover or reinforce action.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when you assign energy to an equipped Upgrade card, gain 2 energy.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: You may treat each of your [hardpoint] upgrade icons as a [torpedoes] or [missiles] upgrade icon. When you are instructed to discard a [torpedoes] or [missiles] Upgrade card, do not discard it.

characteristics.name: Team Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Activation phase, when you reveal a [straight] maneuver, gain 1 additional energy during the "Gain Energy" step.

characteristics.name: Team Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when attacking with a secondary weapon, you may spend 1 energy to change 1 of your blank results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Team Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when a friendly ship at Range 1-3 performs an attack with a [torpedoes] or [missiles] secondary weapon, it may change 1 of its blank results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Team Ability
characteristics.$text: When acquiring a target lock, you may lock onto an enemy ship at Range 1-5 (instead of Range 1-3).

characteristics.name: Hardpoint Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (energy): Spend 2 energy from this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 critical damage and receives 1 ion token. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Hardpoint Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (energy): Spend 1 energy from this card to perform this attack. If this attack does not hit, you may immediately spend 1 energy from this card to perform this attack again.

characteristics.name: Hardpoint Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (energy): Spend 2 energy from this card to perform this attack. The defender doubles his agility value against this attack. You may change 1 of your [focus] results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a recover action, you may spend 1 energy to discard 1 facedown Damage card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a recover action, instead of spending all of your energy, you can choose any amount of energy to spend.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Spend 1 energy to discard 1 of your facedown Damage cards, or spend 3 energy to discard one of your faceup Damage cards.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of each round, you may spend 1 energy to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: After defending, you may discard this card. If you do, each other ship at Range 1 of the defending section rolls 2 attack dice, suffering all damage [hit] and critical damage [critical] rolled.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Energy: Spend 1 energy to remove all stress tokens from a friendly ship at Range 1-3. Then assign 1 focus token to that ship.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: When you obstruct an attack, the defender rolls 3 additional defense dice (instead of 1).

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Immediately before you reveal your maneuver dial, you may spend 1 energy to execute a white [straight 1] maneuver. You cannot use this ability if you would overlap another ship.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a jam action, choose 1 enemy ship that does not have a stress token and is at Range 1 of the jammed ship. The chosen ship receives 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Energy: Spend 5 energy from this card and discard this card to cause each other ship at Range 1 to suffer 1 damage and receive 1 ion token.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: When an enemy ship becomes the active ship during the Combat phase, you may spend 3 energy to force that ship to attack you, if possible, until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose 1 or more enemy ships at Range 1-3 that have a stress token. For each ship chosen, you may spend 1 energy to cause that ship to suffer 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Energy: You may discard this card to gain 3 energy.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: After a ship at Range 1-2 is destroyed, you may choose a discarded [torpedoes], [missiles], [bomb], [cannon], [turret], or Modification Upgrade card that was equipped to your ship and flip it faceup. Then roll 1 attack die. On a blank result, discard Scavenger Crane.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when a friendly ship at Range 1-2 removes a stress token, it may remove 1 additional stress token.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When performing a primary weapon attack, choose up to 2 other friendly ships that have the defender inside their firing arcs at Range 1-3. Remove 1 evade token from each chosen ship to roll 1 additional attack die for each token removed.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When a ship you are touching activates, you may look at its chosen maneuver dial. If you do, its owner must rotate the dial to an adjacent maneuver. The ship can reveal and execute that maneuver even while stressed.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may change all of your [focus] results to [hit] results.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Activation phase, you may discard this card to place 1 container token.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may discard this card to roll 2 additional attack dice.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. At the start of the Combat phase, you may receive a weapons disabled token to flip this card.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, you must choose 1 other ship at Range 1 of the defender to suffer 1 damage. Then flip this card.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End phase, you may receive 1 ion token to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: Turret Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Attack 1 ship (even against a ship outside your firing arc). If the defender is inside your primary firing arc, you may reroll a number of attack dice up to your primary weapon value.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (focus): Attack 1 ship. Your attack dice can be modified only by spending a focus token for its standard effect.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [system] and [salvaged astromech] icons and loses the [crew] upgrade icon. You cannot equip non-unique [salvaged astromech] upgrade cards.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal and execute a maneuver, if you did not overlap a ship, you may discard 1 of your equipped [bomb] Upgrade cards without the "Action:" header to drop the corresponding bomb token.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you have a target lock on the defender, you may spend the target lock to choose any or all defense dice. The defender must reroll the chosen dice.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after defending, you may roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] result, the attacker suffers 1 damage. On a [critical] result, you and the attacker each suffer 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. After you perform a boost or barrel roll action, you may assign 1 focus or evade token to your ship. If you do, flip this card.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Dual card. At the end of the Combat phase, you may spend 1 focus or evade token to flip this card.

characteristics.name: Team Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may change 1 of your [hit] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card, you may spend 1 reinforce token to flip it facedown (without resolving its effect). If you do, until the end of the round, when you are dealt a faceup Damage card, flip it facedown (without resolving its effect).

characteristics.name: Bomb Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal your maneuver, you may drop 1 bomblet token. This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

characteristics.name: Bomb Token Rules
characteristics.$text: When this token detonates, each ship at Range 1 of the token rolls 2 attack dice and suffers all damage [hit] and critical damage [critical] rolled. Then discard this token.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: During setup, after the "Place Forces" step, you may discard any number of your equipped [bomb] Upgrade cards. Place all corresponding bomb tokens in the play area beyond Range 3 of enemy ships.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. You may roll additional attack dice equal to the speed of the maneuver you executed this round, to a maximum of 4 additional dice.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: You can perform actions on your [torpedoes] and [bomb] Upgrade cards even if you are stressed. After you perform an action in this way, you may discard this card to remove 1 stress token from your ship.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: After you receive an ion token, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1. If you do, remove that ion token. Then that ship may choose to receive 1 ion token. If it does, discard this card.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, after the attack resolves, assign the "Harpooned!" Condition to the defender.

characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: When you are hit by an attack, if there is at least 1 uncanceled [critical] result, each other ship at Range 1 suffers 1 damage. Then discard this card and receive 1 facedown damage card. When you are destroyed, each ship at Range 1 suffers 1 damage. Action: Discard this card. Then roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] or [critical] result, suffer 1 damage.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: You may launch bombs using the [straight 5] template instead of dropping them. You cannot launch bombs with the "Action:" header in this way.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with a primary weapon or [cannon] secondary weapon, you may reroll 1 attack die.

characteristics.name: Cannon Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 jam token. Then cancel all dice results.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack with a [torpedoes] or [missiles] secondary weapon that does not hit, each ship at Range 1 of the defender with an agility value lower than the squad point cost of the [torpedoes] or [missiles] Upgrade card must roll 1 attack die and suffer and damage [hit] or critical damage [critical] rolled.

characteristics.name: Illicit Ability
characteristics.$text: When you become the active ship during the Activation phase, you may discard this card and receive 1 stress token. If you do, until the end of the round, you may perform actions and red maneuvers even while you are stressed.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may receive any number of stress tokens to reroll that many attack dice. After performing an attack that hits, you may remove 1 of your stress tokens.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the "Place Forces" step, you may choose to treat your pilot skill value as "0" or "8" until the end of the step.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: You can acquire target locks on friendly ships. You can attack friendly ships.

characteristics.name: Missiles Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, the defender and each other ship at Range 1 receive 1 jam token. Then cancel all results.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: You cannot have more than 1 focus token. During the End phase, do not remove an unused focus token from your ship.

characteristics.name: Tech Ability
characteristics.$text: When an enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-2 becomes the active ship during the Combat phase, you may spend your target lock on that ship to perform a free boost or barrel roll action if that action is on your action bar.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Assign 1 evade token to your ship for each obstacle at Range 1, to a maximum of 2 evade tokens.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Planning phase, you may receive a weapons disabled token to choose a ship at Range 1-3 and assign it the "Scrambled" Condition.

characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: When attacking a ship at Range 1 that is equipped with the "Targeting Scrambler" upgrade, you cannot modify your attack dice. At the end of the Combat phase, remove this card.
